title: Write integration tests for critical auth, upload, and analysis flows
acceptance_criteria: Vitest or Jest configured with test DB setup/teardown scripts
Auth flow tests: signup, login, logout, session persistence, password reset
Upload flow tests: presigned URL request, file upload, confirmation callback
Analysis flow tests: trigger analysis, cache hit/miss, retrieve results
Tenant isolation tests: cross-tenant access returns 404 not data
Rate limit tests: verify 429 after exceeding limits, headers present
Test coverage ≥ 70% on critical service files (lib/analysis/*, lib/tenant/*, lib/storage/*)
